title: Corrected diffusion approximation for random walks conditioned to stay positive
summary: Let $S_n$ be a random walk with i.i.d. increments which have zero mean and finite variance. For every $x\ge0$ we define the stopping time $τ_x:=\inf\{n\ge1:x+S_n\le0\}$ and consider the probabilities $\mathbb{P}(x+S_n\ge y,τ_x>n)$. We study the quality of the normal approximation for these probabilities and derive a Berry-Esseen-type inequality for $\mathbb{P}(x+S_n\ge y|τ_x>n)$. Our Theorem 1 is an extension of the results in our previous paper (arXiv:2412.08502) where we have considered the special case $x=0$.
